title: Six bounded source items added to the review layer
summary: FTFN selected six named source items spanning a funding opportunity, two awards, regional projections, a commodity baseline, and a Toronto planning application. The resulting signals remain In Review and do not establish awards from opportunities, operating facilities, research results, shortages, approvals, or completed housing.
evidence_note: Each source item, claim boundary, and validation result is recorded in the Phase 50 work package.
